name: Sudden Clarity Clarence
look: A crowded photo at a concert or party. In the middle of the cheering crowd, a young man with curly light brown hair and a white T-shirt freezes with wide eyes and parted lips, as if struck by a sudden realization.
use: Captures a moment of sudden insight, often an obvious or absurd one, arriving at an odd time. The top text sets up the situation and the bottom text is the realization.
examples: If I go to bed now
I could wake up rested for once
Wait, if I clean while I cook
There won't be a mountain of dishes after dinner
describe: guy at a concert with a sudden realization face
young man with curly hair staring wide eyed in a party crowd
